note:
身份: 蘑菇沙漠的捕猎者。
关系: 给玩家派发狩猎委托。
说话方式: 爽快务实，谈起旧手机时略带自嘲。
性格与词汇: 关心动物行踪和毛皮，Abiflip 是旧设备品牌。
禁用风格: 不把期限和刷新冷却混淆。

island_messages.text: My name is Trevor, I'm a trapper who specializes in hunting animals all over this island.
island_messages.zh: 我叫 Trevor,是个捕猎者,专门在这座岛上追猎动物。

island_messages.text: I hunt animals that drop pelts, these pelts can be traded over at my friend's shop for valuables.

segments.text: can be traded over at my friend's shop for valuables.
segments.zh: 去我朋友的店里,能换不少好东西。

island_messages.zh: 我猎的动物会掉毛皮,拿这些毛皮去我朋友的店里,能换不少好东西。

island_messages.text: Talk to me again if you would like a task.
island_messages.zh: 想接个活儿的话,再跟我聊聊。

island_messages.text: You will have 10 minutes to find the mob from when you accept the task.
island_messages.zh: 接下任务后,你有 10 分钟找到那只动物。

island_messages.text: Any longer than that and the animal will run away!
island_messages.zh: 超过这个时间,它可就跑远了!

island_messages.text: If you change your mind, you know where to find me!
You can find your %1$s animal near the %2$s.
island_messages.zh: 你的目标是一只%1$s的动物,就在%2$s附近。
island_messages.gloss: 动物档次与地点整体捕获；颜色取当前服务器文本，不把示例的绿色写死。

island_messages.text: Sorry I don't have any animals for you to hunt.
island_messages.zh: 抱歉,现在没有能交给你追猎的动物。

island_messages.text: You already have a mob spawned! Hunt that mob first!
island_messages.zh: 你的目标已经出现了! 先去把那只猎到再说!

island_messages.text: I couldn't locate any animals. Come back in a little bit!
island_messages.zh: 我还没找到动物的踪迹,过会儿再来吧!

island_messages.text: ✆ Eh, I still have an Abiflip.

segments.text: Eh, I still have an Abiflip.
segments.zh: 呃,我还在用 Abiflip 呢。

island_messages.zh: ✆ 呃,我还在用 Abiflip 呢。

island_messages.text: ✆ It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.

segments.text: It has 3 contact slots and I already have Tammy and Tony.
segments.zh: 它只能存 3 个联系人,Tammy 和 Tony 已经占了两个。

island_messages.zh: ✆ 它只能存 3 个联系人,Tammy 和 Tony 已经占了两个。

island_messages.text: ✆ I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!

segments.text: I heard the new models are nice, but they're too smart for me!
segments.zh: 听说新款挺不错,可惜太智能了,我玩不转!

island_messages.zh: ✆ 听说新款挺不错,可惜太智能了,我玩不转!

island_messages.text: ✆ I could add you for let's say... 24 Pelts and 1,000,000 coins?

segments.text: I could add you for let's say...

island_messages.zh: ✆ 要不这样……给我 24 张毛皮和 1,000,000 硬币,我就加你,怎么样?
island_messages.gloss: 实测数字继承默认色，Wiki 为金色；分段读取实时样式，两者不写死。

island_messages.text: ✆ That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.

segments.text: That's awesome, but now my Abiflip is full.
segments.zh: 太好了,不过这下我的 Abiflip 也存满了。

island_messages.zh: ✆ 太好了,不过这下我的 Abiflip 也存满了。

island_messages.text: ✆ You don't have what it takes!

segments.text: You don't have what it takes!
segments.zh: 你还没带够我要的东西!

island_messages.zh: ✆ 你还没带够我要的东西!

island_messages.text: ✆ I'm currently hunting! Don't call again!

segments.text: I'm currently hunting! Don't call again!
segments.zh: 我正打猎呢! 先别打过来了!

island_messages.zh: ✆ 我正打猎呢! 先别打过来了!

source_note: Wiki Dialogue 全部分支与颜色核对，实测补齐首次自我介绍；Abiflip 的品牌和联系人姓名保留英文。网页方括号里的动物档次/地点/倒计时是变量说明，不是原文。

messages.context: 作为花园访客提出委托
messages.text: I've been tracking an animal for the past few days. Got anything I could use as bait?
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 这几天我一直在追踪一只动物。你有能让我当诱饵的东西吗?

messages.text: This should do nicely. I'll have plenty of pelts by the end of the day.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 这些正合适。今天结束前我会有不少毛皮。

messages.text: Looks like I'll have to catch it the old fashioned way.
messages.gloss: 花园访客委托结果台词；社区 Wiki 逐字记录，待游戏内实测。
messages.zh: 看来我只能用老办法抓它了。
